def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    ids,comps=components(grid)
    outside=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; q=deque()
    for r in range(h):
      for c in (0,w-1):
        if grid[r][c]==0 and not outside[r][c]: outside[r][c]=True;q.append((r,c))
    for c in range(w):
      for r in (0,h-1):
        if grid[r][c]==0 and not outside[r][c]: outside[r][c]=True;q.append((r,c))
    while q:
      r,c=q.popleft()
      for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]==0 and not outside[rr][cc]:outside[rr][cc]=True;q.append((rr,cc))
    eligible=set()
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]==0 and not outside[r][c]:
          for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]==1:eligible.add(ids[rr][cc])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]==0 and not outside[r][c]:
          if any(0<=r+dr<h and 0<=c+dc<w and grid[r+dr][c+dc]==1 and ids[r+dr][c+dc] in eligible for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))):out[r][c]=3
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]==1 and ids[r][c] in eligible:
          for dr in (-1,0,1):
            for dc in (-1,0,1):
              rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
              if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]==0 and outside[rr][cc]:out[rr][cc]=2
    return out
